classification.difficultyReason: Use equal tangent lengths to represent the three sides with three shared segment variables, then eliminate variables in the simultaneous equations; the hint supplies the algebraic strategy.

content.prompt:
$I$ is the incentre of $\triangle PQR$. $RQ=8\text{ cm}$, $PR=9\text{ cm}$ and $PQ=7\text{ cm}$. Find $RB$.

Hint: set up a system of 3 simultaneous equations.

spec.description: Schematic incircle with contact labels and marked incentre; no radii or angle bisectors added.
spec.mathematics: C, A and B are the contacts on PR, PQ and RQ respectively. The triangle is not a scale representation of its supplied side lengths.

answer.worked:
Tangents from the same external point are equal. Let $PC=PA=x$, $RC=RB=y$ and $QA=QB=z$, in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}x+y&=9\\x+z&=7\\y+z&=8\\y-z&=2\\2y&=10\\y&=5\end{align*}$$
Thus $RB=5\text{ cm}$.
